fuuga-serve — OpenAI-compatible HTTP server for Fuuga

Usage: fuuga-serve --checkpoint <dir> --tokenizer <dir> [options]
       fuuga-serve --package <path.fuuga> [options]
       fuuga-serve --decision-model <dir> [--decide-* options]  (POST /v1/decide only)
       fuuga-serve mcp [brain] [sandbox]        (run as a local minion; see 'mcp --help')

Options:
  --checkpoint <dir>   Checkpoint directory (step-N folder)
  --tokenizer <dir>    Tokenizer directory
  --package <path>     Load from a .fuuga package (replaces --checkpoint + --tokenizer)
  --host <addr>        Listen address (default: 127.0.0.1)
  --port <N>           Listen port (default: 8080)
  --api-key <key>      Require Bearer token / x-api-key for /v1/* routes
  --model-name <name>  Override model name (default: derived from checkpoint dir)
  --mcp-config <path>  MCP server config file (default: none)
  --api-compat <list>  API shapes, comma-separated: openai, anthropic, jev (typed decisions at
                       POST /v1/systemone, as https://docs.typesafe.ai/api); both = openai,anthropic;
                       all (default). Fuuga's own POST /v1/decide is always served.
  --chat-template <t>  Prompt format: fuuga|llama3|phi3|phi4|gemma3|gemma4|chatml|qwen|mistral
                       (default: read from the tokenizer's turn markers, else fuuga).
                       The wrong template degrades output and suppresses tool calling.
                       For a donor with no name above (deepseek,
                       glm, kimi-k3), pass its template verbatim; any value containing
                       {role} is used as-is, e.g. --chat-template "<|user|>{role}: {content}"
  --observe            Enable request tracing
  --offload cpu        Offload layers to CPU (reduces VRAM usage)
  --gpu-layers <N>     Keep first N layers on GPU (rest offloaded)
  --mmap               Use memory-mapped loading from model.safetensors (faster startup)
  --eager              Load all weights resident instead of letting available memory choose placement
  --s

result.stdout:
fuuga-serve mcp — expose Fuuga as a local minion over MCP (stdio JSON-RPC)

Usage: fuuga-serve mcp [brain] [sandbox]

Advertises the fuuga_delegate tool plus local file tools to a master
agent (e.g. Claude Code). Add it to the master's MCP config to hand
simple errands to a fully-local Fuuga with minimal energy cost.

Identity (so a master can run several distinct minions):
  --name <id>          Server name reported to the master (default: fuuga-minion)
  --role <text>        Specialty woven into the delegate tool description,
                       e.g. 'F# coding errands' — lets the master route by capability

Brain (pick one; default: echo stub that escalates):
  --checkpoint <dir>   A Fuuga-trained model (in-process); pair with --tokenizer
  --tokenizer <dir>    Tokenizer directory for --checkpoint
  --gguf <path>        In-process GGUF model via LLamaSharp (fully local)
  --chat-format <fmt>  Prompt template for --gguf: chatml | llama3 | raw (default: chatml)
  --endpoint <url>     OpenAI-compatible server, e.g. local Ollama/llama.cpp
  --model <name>       Model name for --endpoint (default: local)
  --api-key <key>      Optional bearer token for --endpoint

Sandbox:
  --root <dir>         Workspace root the minion is confined to (default: cwd)
  --allow-write        Permit write_file, replace_in_file, apply_edits and lsp_rename
                       (default: read-only)
  --allow-run          Permit the run_command tool (default: off)
  --run-timeout <secs> run_command timeout (default: 30)

Reach (beyond local files; off by default):
  --web                Enable built-in web tools (web_fetch, wikipedia/github/nuget/npm)
  --mcp-config <path>  Connect to MCP servers from this config and expose their tools
  --lsp-config <path>  Start language servers from this config and expose lsp_diagnostics/
                       lsp_hover/lsp_definition/lsp_references (+ lsp_rename with --allow-write)
  --skills <dir>       Load Anthropic-style SKILL.md skills from <dir> (repeatable;
                       defaults
